messages:
Cara (CS): Hey finance — Kairos Labs (acct KAI-117) flagged their March invoice. They were downgraded mid-cycle but the promo credit didn't prorate; invoice shows full reserved charge + promo. Customer asking for a retro credit. Invoice INV-2026-03-4897. Can someone take a look?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-03-4897 generated 2026-03-12 09:14 UTC. Lines: RESERVED-L x1 (3 GPUs) 2026-03-01 - 2026-03-31 $5,400.00; Promo SPRING50 -50% on reserved base (applied 2026-03-01) ; Usage charges $320.50. Total due $2,770.50.

Ben (AcctOps): Looking. Can you paste the subscription change date + promo code? I can run a proration and issue credit.

Cara (CS): Downgrade effective 2026-03-05. Promo code SPRING50 applied 2026-03-01. They moved Reserved-L (3 GPUs) -> Reserved-M (2 GPUs) because of a migration bug. Expected prorated credit ballpark ~$1.2k. Customer is asking for goodwill since the downgrade was caused by our tooling.

Alice (Finance): Quick Q — was there any usage spike after downgrade that would offset the reserved reduction? If not, I can approve up to $1,500 for goodwill; anything above needs exec sign-off.

Ben (AcctOps): I ran the proration script against their subscription. Output: 
```
Subscription: KAI-117
Change date: 2026-03-05 03:22 UTC
Original reserved: Reserved-L (3 GPUs) monthly: $5,400.00
New reserved: Reserved-M (2 GPUs) monthly: $3,600.00
Prorate days on L: 4 days at L rate -> charge = (4/31)*5400 = $696.77
Prorate days on M: 27 days at M rate -> charge = (27/31)*3600 = $3135.48
Net billed reserved portion = 3832.25
Original billed reserved portion without change = 5400
Delta reserved to credit = 5400 - 3832.25 = 1567.75
Promo SPRING50 applied to entire month reduced billed reserved by 50% -> credit calculation after promo = 1567.75 * 0.5 = 783.875
Addendum: system double-applied a promo discount to usage line erroneously -> additional manual credit 461.80
Total recommended credit = 783.88 + 461.80 = 1,245.68
Suggested memo: CR-2026-03-175
```
(rounded) recommended credit $1,245.68.

Cara (CS): That matches my back-of-envelope. Customer asked us to waive processing fees too. Can we include that?

Alice (Finance): Waiving fee OK. Approve $1,245.68 goodwill + waive reprocessing fee. Ben, you have approval to create and apply the credit memo. Please keep note that this is goodwill due to platform migration bug.

Ben (AcctOps): Creating credit memo now. Journal entry snippet: 
```
CreditMemo: CR-2026-03-175
Customer: KAI-117 (Kairos Labs)
Amount: -1245.68 USD
Applied to: INV-2026-03-4897
Reason: Prorated reserved downgrade + duplicate promo on usage (goodwill)
CreatedBy: Ben (AcctOps)
```
Will post when applied. :hammer_and_wrench:

billing-bot: CreditMemo CR-2026-03-175 created and applied to INV-2026-03-4897 on 2026-03-12 15:02 UTC. Balance adjusted.

Cara (CS): Thanks team — I'll update Kairos and confirm they received the applied credit. They asked for a short note about root cause; I'll attach the migration bug ticket. :thumbsup: :tada:

Alice (Finance): Thanks Ben. Leave a short comment on the customer ledger noting executive-approved threshold not required (amount <$1.5k) and reason = platform migration bug.

Ben (AcctOps): Done — ledger note added, CR-2026-03-175, approver Alice (Finance). Closing thread.
